LegalBot: Quick compliance note: for EUR wires >= €7,500 we need enhanced due diligence (beneficial owner confirmation). If they are on file, OK. If not, request an additional company registry extract. Escalate to Compliance if any mismatch.

```
Bank: EuroChannel Bank, Luxembourg Branch
IBAN: LU12 3456 7890 1234 5678
BIC/SWIFT: ECXL LU LX
Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc. Luxembourg Branch

For fastest processing you can either initiate a SEPA/SWIFT wire to the attached IBAN or we can provide a one-time EUR payment link if you prefer. If wiring, please attach a signed wire authorization and a bank letter/statement showing the IBAN and beneficiary name, plus a bank contact for verification. Reply here with the docs and we'll expedite posting today."
HelixBilling (via email posted by Iris): "Uploading signed wire form and bank letter now; bank will send SWIFT confirmation once processed."
